Planning help

Get the size right the first time

Answer these before you order beams, corbels, shutters or moulding.

Hero image
Hands holding a tape measure up to a kitchen ceiling where a beam will run, painter's tape outlining the beam's width on the drywall, a pencil tucked behind an ear. Natural daylight.

Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }}, most sizing mistakes happen before anyone opens a product page. These questions catch them.

Four questions to answer first

1
How long is the run?
Measure wall to wall for beams. For moulding, total every wall and add extra for cuts.
2
How big should it look?
Tape a paper template where it will go and look from across the room. Size to the space, not the photo.
3
What's it fastened to?
Know what's behind it: joists, studs or sheathing.
4
Does it hold anything?
If a corbel or bracket will carry a shelf or counter, call us before you choose one.

Can't find your size? Our Design Your Own builders make custom faux wood beams, corbels, brackets and flat trim at off-the-shelf prices. Custom pieces are made to order, so they can't be returned. Double-check your numbers, or send them to us first.
